FM05.reasoning: The dataset has a strong temporal component (the test set is chronologically after the train set), but the agent uses a random split for cross-validation, which ignores temporal distribution shifts and introduces look-ahead bias.

other_failure_modes.name: Invalid submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent creates the final submission using a generated sequence of integers instead of preserving and using the actual identifier column from the test set. This will result in a failed submission or a score of zero.

other_failure_modes.name: Missing top-k predictions
other_failure_modes.description: For a ranking task evaluated on NDCG@k, the agent only outputs the single top prediction per instance instead of the allowed top-k predictions, failing to capture partial credit for correct predictions ranked 2nd to kth.

summary: The agent performs extensive and well-designed feature engineering, along with sophisticated target encoding and ensemble calibration. However, it fails to account for the temporal nature of the dataset during cross-validation, risking look-ahead bias. More critically, the final submission generation is flawed: it uses generated sequential integers instead of the actual test set IDs, and it only submits the top 1 prediction per user for an NDCG@5 ranking task, which throws away significant partial credit.
